title: BP Energy Outlook 2035
scenario_note: bp focuses on the 'most likely' base case; alternative cases include a low GDP case and a China electrification sensitivity.

entries.subject: renewables
entries.metric: renewables share of primary energy (renewables incl. biofuels, excl. hydro)
entries.quote: Among non-fossil fuels, renewables (including biofuels) gain share rapidly, from around 3% today to 8% by 2035, overtaking nuclear in the early 2020s and hydro in the early 2030s.
entries.note: The 2015 summary table gives 7.5% for 2035 when computed as (renewables + biofuels) / total; the text says 8%. Both kept.

entries.subject: renewables

entries.note: Computed as renewables / total primary energy from the table (414.9 / 13186.5). Not a figure bp prints. Renewables include the table's biofuels row (bp's 'renewables (including biofuels)').
